title: Your fall weekend by the river

voice.instructions: Read the supplied script verbatim, like a friendly outdoor creator telling a friend about a useful camping app. Warm, casual, lightly enthusiastic, confident and unhurried. Aim for 145 to 155 words per minute. Let the opening question breathe. The reservation sentence is a helpful heads-up, not a warning. Give gentle emphasis to campsites, your dates, and same app. Use natural contractions as written, brief breaths between ideas, and a relaxed final sentence. Eddy sounds like Eddie; Current is the river name; Jacks Fork is two words; Recreation.gov is recreation dot gov. No announcer voice, exaggerated accent, whispering, fake testimonial, additional words, or rushed ending. No music or sound effects.

scenes.text: Thinking about a fall camping weekend on the Current or Jacks Fork?
scenes.visual: Authentic Current or Jacks Fork river/campsite footage; lead with the water and autumn atmosphere.

scenes.text: Here’s something to know: developed campgrounds in Ozark National Scenic Riverways now require reservations.
scenes.visual: Continue river/campground footage. Caption the full claim; small context label: Ozark National Scenic Riverways • Developed campgrounds.

scenes.text: Eddy helps you put the weekend together. You can browse campgrounds by river, check photos, and see which campsites have openings for your dates.
scenes.visual: Real iPhone capture: camping grouped by river, open campground, browse photos, show individual site availability. Cut across these actions within this passage.

scenes.text: There’s a calendar view, too, so if your weekend’s flexible, you can look ahead.
scenes.visual: Slow horizontal scroll through the availability calendar. Keep dates and availability legend legible.

scenes.text: And you can check river levels and the weather in the same app, so you’ve got a better idea of what to expect before you leave.
scenes.visual: Show the relevant river's gauge/condition and reading timestamp, then the weather. Do not imply a gauge certifies campsite safety.

scenes.text: Once you find your spot, Eddy takes you to Recreation.gov to book.
scenes.visual: Tap Book campsite for the same supported NPS campground; hold on the matching Recreation.gov destination before checkout.

scenes.text: Pick your weekend. Find your campsite. Get outside with Eddy.
scenes.visual: Return to authentic river/camp footage, then Eddy mascot and an iOS download end card with eddy.guide/app.
